candidates.requirement: Compilation in this target's pattern and compile-context surface must be able to select PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT and reject an explicit (?C) callout with PCRE2_ERROR_CALLOUT_CALLER_DISABLED.
candidates.target_route: Use an eight-byte option prefix followed by the finite pattern (?C). The entry creates a compile context, passes it to pcre2_compile, and the parser reads extra_options from that context.
candidates.failure_condition: The target sets only the compiled-length limit on its compile context. No input bit or other target call sets PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT, so the parser's new rejection guard cannot be true and the supported error-203 behavior cannot be reached.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete target uses the same compile context for both compile passes and never calls pcre2_set_compile_extra_options. Its second pass only changes ordinary compile options; matching and DFA occur after compilation and cannot supply the missing compile-context bit.
